name: marsx/ppo-l1-reference
intendedUse: Reference local-navigation policy for MARS-X L1 (geometry) on the Jezero 2 m planning grid: a baseline to compare user models against, and a demo of real learning.
limitations: Trained on synthetic start/goal pairs 20-120 m apart in the north part of the grid (rows < 768) and evaluated on the unseen south part. Sees only an 11x11 local window (22 m): dead ends larger than that cause failures; long routes need global waypoints (A*). Not trained with lighting, energy, comms or hidden rocks (L2/L3). Not a flight-ready controller.
